newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran confirms Balal oil deal, not with Bow Valley.
newsitem.headline: Iran confirms Balal oil deal, not with Bow Valley.

text.p: Iran on Saturday confirmed it had signed a second deal with a foreign company to develop Iranian oilfields.
"We have signed a contract for Balal," said Mohammad Nejadhosseinian, Deputy Minister for International Affairs at Iran's oil ministry.
He said Canada's Bow Valley would not be involved in the contract.

On Friday, a National Iranian Oil Comapany (NIOC) official said the contract for the 35,000 bpd development had been awarded to a joint venture between Canada's Bow Valley and the privately owned U.K. Pell Frischmann.
Nejadhosseinian would neither confirm or deny whether Pell Frischmann had been given the contract.
"We will announce the company in two weeks, he said.
Industry sources on Friday said financing for the field had not yet been arranged.
The oilfield is believed to require some $150 million for development, well above the $40 million limit set by U.S sanctions against non-U.S. firms that invest in Iran's energy sector.
